column4: Total liabilities (including minority interest before 2001): RCFD2948 as filed from 1984Q1. Where it is blank (before 1984, and ~2% of banks in 1984-85), liabilities net of subordinated debt (RCFD2950, filed 1976-2010) + subordinated debt (RCFD3200): exact, 2948 = 2950 + 3200 for 100% of banks in every 1984 quarter where both are filed (and liabilities_ex_subdebt shows the identity 1985-2010). For banks with foreign offices the FFIEC 014 did not collect consolidated subordinated debt in 1976-1983, so their total liabilities is total assets minus equity (RCFD2170 - RCFD3210), both collected from them throughout: on the FFIEC 031, 2948 = 2170 - 3210 for 98-100% of foreign-office banks 1984-2000.

Total deposits, consolidated: domestic offices (RCON2200) plus foreign offices (RCFN2200). Equals the reported RCFD2200 exactly before 2011; after 2011 RCFD2200 is not consolidated in the source files (see the header of core_series.csv).
Total liabilities net of subordinated notes and debentures: RCFD2950 as filed to 2010; liabilities - subdebt after (identical 1985-2010).
Total loans and leases gross of unearned income: RCFD1400 as filed to 2010; ll_tot (RCFD2122) + unearned income (RCFD2123) after (identical 1985-2010).

Loans to individuals for household, family and other personal expenditures (consumer loans): RCFD1975 as filed to 2010; credit cards and revolving plans plus other consumer loans after (identical from 1990).

Total interest expense on deposits: RIAD4170 as filed to 2010; after, foreign-office interest (RIAD4172) + domestic transaction (4508) + savings (0093) + time deposits (A517+A518 to 2016, HK03+HK04 from 2017), identical to the reported total 1987-2010.
Total operating income: RIAD4000 as filed to 2010; total interest income + total noninterest income after (identical 1985-2010).
Total operating expense (excludes the loan-loss provision from 1985): RIAD4130 as filed to 2010; total interest expense + total noninterest expense after (identical 1985-2010).

Investment securities, excluding trading: total investment securities (RCFD0390) to 1993; held-to-maturity at amortized cost (1754) + available-for-sale at fair value (1773) from 1994, plus equity securities with readily determinable fair value (JA22) from 2018 when they left AFS. The 1994 break is indistinguishable from an ordinary quarter.
